name: algonote
description: Smart Note-First study companion: active recall quizzes, AI note fill, structural linting, and spaced repetition tracking.

chatParticipants.name: algo
chatParticipants.description: AlgoNote assistant for linting, templates, and complexity analysis

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Lint the current DSA note for missing structures

commands.name: mcq
commands.description: Generate practice questions based on current note

commands.name: dryrun
commands.description: Generate a dry-run trace table for the code

commands.name: template
commands.description: Insert boilerplate for a specific DSA topic

commands.name: interview
commands.description: Conduct a mock interview on the current note

commands.name: grill
commands.description: Timed rapid-fire challenge on the current note

algonote.customTemplatePath.description: Custom path to a Markdown template file (relative to workspace or absolute). If empty, AlgoNote checks .algonote/template.md, TEMPLATE.md, or uses the built-in standard template.

algonote.strictPreflightCheck.description: Enforce strict preflight check before tests/interviews (requires notes to be complete).

enumDescriptions: Standard multiple choice testing complexity & edge cases
Conceptual recall questions explained in words
algonote.quizFormat.description: Select default quiz question type format.

enumDescriptions: GitHub Copilot (built-in, no API key needed)
Google Gemini API (requires Gemini API Key)
Custom OpenAI-compatible API (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, LocalAI, etc.)
algonote.aiProvider.description: Select AI Provider for generating note details and quiz questions.

algonote.copilotModel.description: Copilot model family to use when Provider is set to 'copilot'.

algonote.geminiApiKey.description: API Key for Google Gemini API (Required if Provider is 'gemini').

algonote.ollamaUrl.description: Endpoint URL for local Ollama server (Required if Provider is 'ollama').

algonote.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model name (e.g. llama3, mistral, qwen2.5-coder).

algonote.customEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL (Required if Provider is 'custom').

algonote.customApiKey.description: API Key for Custom OpenAI-compatible API.

algonote.customModel.description: Model name for Custom API (e.g. gpt-4o, deepseek-chat, mistral-large).

enumDescriptions: Full panel in the main editor group (ViewColumn.One)
Full panel beside the main editor (ViewColumn.Two)
Web version opened in default web browser
algonote.quizLocation.description: Select where the Active Recall Quiz should be launched when starting a quiz.

algonote.quizCount.description: Number of questions to generate for the quiz.
